why: The retry exists for one failure -- `verify (floor)` went red on `main` on 2026-09-21 with HTTP 504 from the shellcheck release asset, on a tree that touched no workflow -- and it must not swallow the opposite failure. Retrying every status makes a 404 from a wrong or withdrawn pin take three attempts and a backoff before failing, and buries the status that says the pin is wrong behind 'after 3 attempt(s)'. The download still succeeds and the digest check is untouched, so nothing else in the tool notices.
killedBy: workflow lint download retry retries the statuses that are transient, and not the ones that mean a wrong pin
